One potential upside to a slowdown in the capex cycle is that it may put the Mag7 back in favor. We can see below that the P/E ratio of the M7 has diverged considerably from the P/PO (payout) multiple, ever since the M7 started spending their cashflows on capex instead of buybacks. As the payout ratio (dividends plus buybacks as a percentage of earnings) started falling from 90% to 29%, the P/E-multiple declined accordingly. My math suggests that if this had not happened, the Mag 7 could be trading at twice their current multiple. Between strength in the broader tape and this possible outcome, I could see a scenario in which the bull market (both cyclical and secular) can keep going, even without help from the AI picks and shovels.
